name: trading-analysis
description: Proposal-only value-stock research and portfolio monitoring

interface.shortDescription: Research stocks and monitor holdings without placing orders.
interface.longDescription: Screens sourced value-stock research, sizes one proposal at a time, evaluates holdings, and builds read-only portfolio dashboard snapshots. It cannot place brokerage orders.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review my holdings and build a portfolio dashboard snapshot without placing orders.
